undocumented.title: Option codes 5 and 8 drive navigation to sub-screens
undocumented.code_does: Entering '5' against a department row calls the Employees program for that department; entering '8' calls the NewEmp program to add a new employee to that department.
undocumented.why_it_matters: The valid option codes and their effects are not documented in the specification rules for this cluster, so their correctness cannot be audited.

undocumented.title: Selection field is blanked after each option is processed
undocumented.code_does: After processing a changed subfile row, the program clears XSEL to blank and updates the subfile record, preventing the same option from being re-processed on the next interaction.
undocumented.why_it_matters: This implicit reset behaviour is not described in the spec; a user who enters options on multiple rows would see them cleared after submission.

undocumented.title: XNAME display field is 38 characters wide but DEPTNAME column is VARCHAR(36)
undocumented.code_does: The XNAME subfile field is declared as 38A in the display file, two characters wider than the VARCHAR(36) DEPTNAME column in the DEPARTMENT table DDL.
undocumented.why_it_matters: The two extra characters are never populated, but the discrepancy may indicate a copy-paste error or an undocumented layout margin that could mislead future maintenance.

undocumented.title: Subfile is fully loaded into memory before display (no lazy/paged fetch)
undocumented.code_does: LoadSubfile fetches all rows from the DEPARTMENT cursor in a loop and writes every row to the subfile before the screen is shown, rather than loading pages on demand.
undocumented.why_it_matters: For large department tables approaching the 9,999-entry maximum, the load time could be noticeable; this eager-load pattern is not mentioned in the specification.
